Alex: Quick sync — proposing next release train Wed 09:00 PT. Plan to roll api-service -> runtime -> console.
Maria: 👍 Is Dedicated capacity scheduled to be drained? We need to avoid mid-deploy resizes.
Alex: Good call. @infra-team please freeze autoscale from 08:30–11:30 PT. I'll put a policy in the console.
Jamal: Who's owner for smoke checks for runtime? I can take it but need a checklist.
Olivia: I'll own runtime smoke. Quick checklist: health endpoint, 95th latency under 200ms, KV cache warm.
Ben: For canary, suggest 10% for 20 mins, then 50% for 15, then full. Rollback if error rate > 1% or latency regresses > 25%.
Alex: Sounds good. Owners:
```
09:00 api-service -> Maria (canary 10% 10m)
09:30 runtime -> Olivia (canary 10% 20m)
10:15 console -> Jamal (straight 50% then ramp)
```
Maria: Will schedule the ci gating and mark PRs as ready. cc @ci-bot to queue the pipelines.
ci-bot: queued pipeline for release/train-2026-03-18, passing premerge checks (build, unit, lint).
deploy-bot: reminder — ensure rollback tags exist: release/train-2026-03-18 and release/train-2026-03-18-rollback
Jamal: I'll run smoke script after each canary and post results here. Link to rollback playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback
Alex: If anyone needs to shift timing, please say by EOD tomorrow. Otherwise I'll lock the train at 17:00 PT today. :lock:
Maria: OK locking from my side. I'll also add a note to console: expected downtime none, watchlist: infra/db, cache.
Olivia: I'll bring the perf dashboard up and add alerts to pages if thresholds cross.
Ben: One more — database migration? small additive idx in api-service?
Maria: yes, migration is online and reversible, plan to run during api-service canary.
Alex: Great. Thanks all — will post final manifest when locked.
